snippet.title: Thousand Hells Release Window Trailer - Story-Rich Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Developer A Sharp and publisher Kitfox Games is pleased to announce that the  tactical narrative game, Thousand Hells:  The Underworld Heists is releasing on Steam in Fall 2026. Form a team and face the trials of hell in an anthology of Underworld stories with over 200 unique dynamic narrative encounters and 100s of hand-painted illustrations.

Wishlist Thousand Hells Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3794210/Thousand_Hells_The_Underworld_Heists/
